findings.title: PropertyResourceBundle loaded with wrong charset mangles UTF-8 translations
findings.body: File is loaded with new PropertyResourceBundle(FileInputStream) at line 68 (and English file at line 77), which decodes as ISO-8859-1, while the message properties files contain raw UTF-8 (Chinese, Arabic, Thai, etc.). Non-ASCII values are garbled before sanitizing, so comparison of sanitized vs value is done on mojibake and can both miss real HTML and produce false Illegal HTML reports. Use a Reader with UTF-8.

findings.title: Missing English file throws RuntimeException instead of reporting
findings.body: If the derived englishFile cannot be opened, verifySafeHtml throws RuntimeException at line 79, aborting the whole theme-verifier mojo. A missing/corrupt reference file should produce a MojoExecutionException or a collected message like other checks, not crash the build.

findings.title: Anchor check iterates stale matcher while mutating value
findings.body: santizeAnchors creates Matcher on the original value then mutates value with replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(...)) inside the while(matcher.find()) loop. The matcher still walks the old CharSequence, and replaceFirst removes the first literal occurrence anywhere, not the matched offset. With duplicate or reordered anchors the wrong tag can be removed, letting a changed malicious href pass or flagging a correct file. Iterate over lists or track offsets instead.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account bundle is now Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare: which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Same mistake in login/messages_lt.properties. Stripping HTML should not replace the sentence with another locale's text.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese file uses Traditional characters
findings.body: totpStep1 in messages_zh_CN.properties is now in Traditional Chinese (手機, 應用程式之一) while zh_CN must be Simplified (手机, 应用程序). The sanitizer fix copied the zh_TW wording into the zh_CN file.

findings.title: Java ChoiceFormat syntax breaks JS {{}} interpolation contract
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from Attribute {{0}} ... {{2}} value(s) to Attribute {0} ... {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}. The account-ui and admin-ui bundles are consumed by JavaScript React/i18n code that interpolates {{0}}, not Java MessageFormat. Single-brace ChoiceFormat will be rendered literally and pluralization will not work in the UI.
